plugins.name: onsystem
plugins.description: Keeps coding agents on your design system: it catches palette colors, native elements and APIs your system lacks, at every edit and pull request, with the fix. Set it up once in your design-system package; every app in your monorepo gets it. Runs locally and works alongside @shadcn/lint.
